description.short: Engineering intelligence in Copilot Chat, via GitHub's hosted MCP server.
description.full: A Microsoft 365 Declarative Agent that turns scattered GitHub signals (pull requests, reviews, issues, commits) into one-sentence answers inside Copilot Chat. Built declaratively with zero hosted backend on top of GitHub's hosted Remote MCP Server with per-user OAuth 2.0: each user signs in with their own GitHub identity, and the agent acts strictly within their permissions. Demonstrates Work IQ via Skills and Tools, MCP Apps packaging, External MCP server integration, and OAuth security for MCP.
